error_reason: The WebSurfer observed the birth year '1933' explicitly visible on the search result page for Kim Dae-hwan but failed to extract and report this critical data to the Planner. This omission forced the agents into a futile loop of redundant searches, as the Planner could not have deduced the answer from the available evidence had the WebSurfer simply reported the visible text.

hypotheses.rationale: This is the decisive error. The WebSurfer performed the search for 'Kim Dae-hwan birth date End of Winter director' and returned a search results page, but failed to extract or report the visible text (which likely contained the correct birth year). Instead of reporting the data found (or the lack thereof with context), it only provided a generic snippet containing HTML metadata ('viewport', 'HandheldFriendly'). This failure to extract critical data forced the Planner into a cycle of repeatedly asking for searches that yielded identical, unhelpful results.
hypotheses.check: Re-run the search query 'Kim Dae-hwan birth date End of Winter director' at Step 8 (or similar queries at Steps 10-18) and manually inspect the full search result snippets (not just the first sentence) to see if the birth year is visible but was ignored by the agent.

The hypothesis suggests the agent failed to extract/report visible text; the evidence confirms this by showing the specific biographical data ('Born: 1933') was present on the screen but not included in the textual report provided to the Planner.
